hints.title: Evaluate Subarray Intervals by Length
hints.text: Build solutions for shorter subarray intervals first before considering longer intervals.

hints.title: Check Equal Endpoints
hints.text: If arr[i] == arr[j], removing the internal palindrome can simultaneously remove the endpoints at cost max(1, dp[i + 1][j - 1]).

hints.title: Split Across Internal Boundaries
hints.text: For each interval i to j, test all partition points k to take minimum of dp[i][k] + dp[k + 1][j].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedily removing palindromic subsegments leads to suboptimal step counts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval dynamic programming explores all valid partitions in O(N^3) time and O(N^2) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the equal endpoint transition dp[i + 1][j - 1] carefully.
complexity.notes: Single elements cost 1 move; two equal elements cost 1 move.
